ruleset: Standard international (Western) chess — pawn double-step, en passant, castling, promotion, check, checkmate, stalemate, fifty-move, threefold repetition and insufficient material. Not Thai chess (Makruk); Thai is only an interface language.

session.note: Wall-clock time from the OpenCode session's creation to the capture that produced this file: a complete game (engine, renderer, academy, audio, persistence), repository, verification suite and release documentation. Deployment fields are updated after the GitHub Pages check.

usage.note: Read from the OpenCode session database (session_v2) at capture time. totalTokens sums all five counters; cache reads are repeated prompt context and dominate the figure. costUSD is 0 on the flat-rate plan.
